title: An Exact Dominant Degree Condition for Transitive Tournament Factors in Digraphs
summary: Let $r\ge2$, let $T_r$ denote the transitive tournament on $r$ vertices, and write $d_G^*(v):=\max\{d_G^+(v),d_G^-(v)\}$. We prove that if $r\mid n$ and an $n$-vertex digraph $G$ satisfies $d_G^*(x)+d_G^*(y)\ge 2(1-1/r)n-1$ for every $x\ne y \in V(G)$ with $xy \notin E(G)$, then $G$ has a $T_r$-factor, and the bound is best possible.
